law: Every artifact the platform is built from — a code file, a table, an API route, a state machine, a capability, a registry list, a console screen, a page — belongs to exactly one business domain below. A business domain is a sub-entity of the foundation domain named as its `foundation`. Nothing is owned twice and nothing is unowned (test/domain-map.js); each domain's documentation — overview, API, architecture, data model, data flow, process flows, user interface and a manual for each of its users — is generated from this file and the code (scripts/domain-docs.js), so it cannot drift.

domains.name: Identity
domains.purpose: Who someone is: accounts, sign-in by every method (password, one-time code, magic link, passkey, single sign-on), sessions, provisioning from directories, and platform administrators' own accounts.

domains.name: Access and roles
domains.purpose: What someone may do: store roles and staff, platform roles, permission sections and scopes, and the policies that grant or refuse.

domains.name: Customers
domains.purpose: The people and organisations a store sells to: their profiles and addresses, segments they belong to, and leads not yet customers.

domains.name: Stores and organisation
domains.purpose: The stores on the platform and how each is organised: creating and configuring a store from its setup answers, its departments and org units, its tenancy tree and its look.

domains.name: Modules and capabilities
domains.purpose: What a store has switched on: the modules the platform sells to stores, the capabilities inside them, their parameters, presets and availability rules.

domains.name: Platform billing
domains.purpose: What the platform charges its stores: plans, subscriptions to plans, usage metering, invoices and credit notes.

domains.name: Catalogue
domains.purpose: Everything a store sells, described once: products and their variants and SKUs, brands, the category tree, attributes, the platform master every product is described on, the global catalogue and contributions back to it.

domains.name: Product content
domains.purpose: How a product is presented beyond its facts: rich content modules, images and comparison blocks, reviewed before they show.

domains.name: Product options
domains.purpose: Choices on one product instead of a product per combination: option groups (sizes, toppings, engravings) with their values and price changes, attached to any product.

domains.name: Inventory
domains.purpose: How much of what is where: stock per SKU and warehouse, store-level stock, transfers between locations and serial-numbered items.

domains.name: Pricing
domains.purpose: The price a buyer pays before any offer: price lists per segment with quantity tiers, and demand-based surge pricing.

domains.name: Currencies and exchange
domains.purpose: Every unit of value and how they convert: currencies, points and credits, and exchange rates.

domains.name: Offers
domains.purpose: Every reason a buyer pays less or gets more: offers and discounts of every type, coupons, cashback, rewards, gift cards and vouchers, deals and countdowns, group buying, price matching and trade-ins, the funding and settlement of each, and their governance.

domains.name: Affiliates and creators
domains.purpose: Who brings buyers and what they earn: affiliate networks and tiers, tracked clicks and conversions, commission rules and affiliate payouts.

domains.name: Advertising
domains.purpose: Paid placement: sellers' sponsored products and creatives competing in an auction for slots, and what each impression and click costs.

domains.name: Cart and checkout
domains.purpose: From the bag to a placed order: bag lines and their terms, service fees and tips, buy now, try and buy, the payment step and the order it writes.

domains.name: Orders
domains.purpose: What was bought and what happens to it: orders and their lines, their life from placement to delivery, and substitutions proposed when an item is out.

domains.name: Returns and refunds
domains.purpose: Sending something back: return requests, their inspection and refund, and payment disputes.

domains.name: Payment gateways
domains.purpose: Taking money: the gateways a store accepts and their methods, payment attempts and captures, gateway callbacks, payment links, QR and instant-bank collection, mandates, escrow and split payments.

domains.name: Wallets
domains.purpose: Value a party holds: wallets of any definition, the ledger every movement is posted to, holds, transfers between wallets and between people.

domains.name: Settlements and payouts
domains.purpose: Paying those who are owed: seller settlements, payout batches, bank payouts, reconciliation of what the bank says against what the ledger says, and remittances.

domains.name: Financial services
domains.purpose: Financial products sold to buyers: bill payments, recharges, insurance, and credit — pay later and loans with their instalments.

domains.name: Tax
domains.purpose: What tax applies and how much: tax modes, rules by place and product, and how tax is shown and charged.

domains.name: Subscriptions and memberships
domains.purpose: Buying again on a schedule and belonging to a programme: subscribe-and-save schedules and their cycles, and membership tiers with their perks.

domains.name: Shipping and delivery
domains.purpose: Getting goods to the buyer: carriers and rates, shipments and tracking, pickup points and lockers, and fast local delivery from dark stores with slots, riders and dispatch runs.

domains.name: Supply and planning
domains.purpose: Keeping shelves full: suppliers, which supplier provides what, purchase requests and their approval, and replenishment plans.

domains.name: Services and appointments
domains.purpose: Selling time and work: bookings of resources and slots, live audio and video sessions and charging them by the minute, and services attached to an item — installation, assembly and extended warranties.

domains.name: Digital goods
domains.purpose: What is delivered without shipping: licence keys from a pool, course access and progress, and the deliverables machinery other domains use.

domains.name: Health and pharmacy
domains.purpose: What health commerce needs: prescriptions checked before sale, verified practitioners, lab tests and their reports, and the shopper's own health records shared with consent.

domains.name: Made to order
domains.purpose: Items made for one buyer: the buyer's own artwork proofed before making, and samples sold at their own price.

domains.name: Mobility
domains.purpose: Moving people: rides requested and dispatched, drivers and their vehicles, and fleets.

domains.name: Business operations
domains.purpose: Running the business behind the store: people and payroll, manufacturing work orders, and projects with their tasks.

domains.name: Marketplace
domains.purpose: Many sellers in one store: seller onboarding and health, offers competing for the buy box, fulfilment by the store, buyer protection claims, brand protection, and shoppers selling their own items.

domains.name: Negotiation and auctions
domains.purpose: Prices agreed rather than listed: offers and counter-offers between a buyer and a seller, and timed auctions with proxy bidding.

domains.name: Business-to-business trade
domains.purpose: Buying between businesses: requests for quotation and quotes, tenders and bids, contracts, trade assurance, supplier verification and membership tiers, export documents, letters of credit and minimum order quantities.

domains.name: Lists, alerts and history
domains.purpose: What a shopper keeps and watches: wish lists and gift registries, saved and compared items, price and stock alerts, and what they viewed.

domains.name: Reviews and questions
domains.purpose: What buyers say: ratings and reviews with replies and votes, and questions with answers.

domains.name: Messages and notifications
domains.purpose: Talking to people: conversations between buyers, sellers and staff, notifications to shoppers and staff, email, and marketing campaigns sent through connected messaging providers.

domains.name: Customer support
domains.purpose: Helping people: tickets with service levels and agents, and requests a store decides — price matches, prescriptions, credentials, enquiries, trade-ins — as cases of declared kinds.

domains.name: Storefront and content
domains.purpose: What a shopper sees: the home page's banners and cards, themes and their assignment, and the pages and their layout.

domains.name: Search and discovery
domains.purpose: Finding things: search, suggestions and facets, and recommendations.

domains.name: Search engine optimisation
domains.purpose: Being found from outside: the sitemap and its files, page metadata and product feeds.

domains.name: Languages and localisation
domains.purpose: Speaking the buyer's language: the message catalogues of every language and a store's own wording.

domains.name: Consoles
domains.purpose: The frames every domain's screens sit in: the store console and the platform console — signing in, navigation, layout, the shared table, form and chart parts — and nothing of any domain's own.

domains.name: Analytics and reports
domains.purpose: Knowing how the business does: dashboards and their widgets, reports and store statistics.

domains.name: Experiments
domains.purpose: Testing what works: experiments with variants, who sees which, and what converts.

domains.name: Risk and fraud
domains.purpose: Stopping abuse: fraud screening of orders and payments, risk events and the block list.

domains.name: Compliance and privacy
domains.purpose: Meeting obligations: controls and their evidence, certifications, know-your-customer checks, consent, and privacy requests to see or erase data.

domains.name: Audit
domains.purpose: What happened, provably: the hash-chained audit trail, its verification, retention, the trash and exports.

domains.name: Security
domains.purpose: Protecting the platform: encryption and key rotation, the security policy and scorecard, idempotency and request protection.

domains.name: AI
domains.purpose: Machine help: AI providers and gateways, AI tasks and their metering.

domains.name: Integrations and webhooks
domains.purpose: Connecting outside systems: connectors and providers registered as data, custom providers, outgoing webhooks and their deliveries, incoming events.

domains.name: Kernel and registries
domains.purpose: The foundation every domain is built on: kinds, entities, identifiers, hierarchies, versions in time, settings resolved by context, the event log, and the registries and entity definitions the console edits.

domains.name: Rules, states and settings
domains.purpose: How behaviour is configured: applicability rules, state machines, settings and their defaults, and platform policy.

domains.name: Places and time
domains.purpose: Where and when: countries, subdivisions and places, coordinate systems, calendars and time.

domains.name: Platform knowledge
domains.purpose: The platform describing itself: the constitution, its foundations, universes, catalogue, coverage, traceability and documents.

domains.name: Runtime and operations
domains.purpose: Running the platform: environments, configuration, the database and its migrations, queues, monitoring, metrics, logs, backup and restore.
